role: Local-only UserDefaults counters (shown/completed/skipped) for the pre-score subjective prompt, surfaced as a one-line summary in Diagnostics; each record call counts on from the stored value.
types: PreScorePromptTelemetry: final class (@Observable, @MainActor) — counters for the pre-score prompt
state: ud:preScorePrompt.telemetry.firstSeen (legacy, written by earlier builds; only removed by reset)

units.does: Loads the three counters from the given UserDefaults (standard by default).
Sets shownCount to the stored shownCount + 1 and persists it, so a sweep of the key is not undone by a stale in-memory total. Called from PreScorePromptView .task.

flags.text: Delete All My Data sweeps the preScorePrompt.telemetry.* keys but never calls reset(), so Diagnostics keeps showing the old in-memory counts until the next record call (which now counts on from the swept, zero value). DataPurgeService should call reset() (handed off).

units.does: Sets completedCount to the stored completedCount + 1 and persists it (Show my score with ≥1 answer).
Sets skippedCount to the stored skippedCount + 1 and persists it (Skip / dismiss with no answers).
completed/shown as Double; nil when never shown.
One-line Diagnostics string: 'not yet shown' when shown is 0, else completed/shown with rounded percent and skipped count (unlocalized English).

flags.text: diagnosticsSummary is hard-coded English shown via Text(verbatim:) in Diagnostics, while the sibling ValidationTelemetry.diagnosticsSummary localizes its labels and docs/LOCALIZATION.md requires every user-facing string to go through String(localized:bundle:).

units.does: Zeroes the three counters and removes their keys plus the legacy firstSeen key. Wired to Diagnostics reset button.
